svg.text: Web UI → FastAPI backend → LLM + NLI pipeline (Stage 1 recommend, Stage 2 explain, NLI verify)
PyPI / npm metadata → SPDX IDs; unknown flagged, never guessed
requirements → exactly 3 licenses from the catalogue
anchor + keyword match → only the relevant clauses
each cites a clause ID + exact quote
quote must exist in cited clause, then clause ⟹ claim?
entail = verified · neutral = unverified · contra = contradicted
ranked licenses · labelled claims · warnings · timings
Offline: data preparation & evaluation (not in the request path)
runs the same pipeline in batch
